name: runtime-diagnostics
description: Revisor process and merge observability: bounded secret-safe JSONL delivery, process heartbeat and ending classification, merge-stage events, and review-worker lifecycle events. Logging is best-effort and must not change signal, merge, or worker behavior.
cardTemplate: Summarise the runtime-diagnostics domain: secret-safe JSONL delivery, heartbeat and process-ending evidence, merge-stage events, and review-worker lifecycle observation that never changes runtime behavior.
specRefs: runtime-diagnostics — how the service ended, in its own log
runtime-diagnostics — event inventory and secret-safe output boundary
runtime-diagnostics — heartbeat interval and event-loop lag contract
runtime-diagnostics — signal observation preserves shutdown behavior
rationale: Diagnostics is an output boundary, not merge policy or worker scheduling. The dedicated modules own record safety and process observation; narrow worker membership covers only the lifecycle points that emit diagnostics, while local-merge and LocalPrService remain in their existing publication and PR-lifecycle domains.
